entries.prompt: ONE transparent PNG painted educational chemistry asset. Landscape 3:2, side elevation slight depth. Complete scientifically correct school SIMPLE DISTILLATION apparatus. Left round-bottom flask one third clear liquid and boiling chips in electric heating mantle. Retort stand with clamps. Above flask still head with thermometer bulb EXACTLY AT HEIGHT OF SIDE ARM. Side arm slopes right into Liebig condenser with outer water jacket, TWO hose connectors: lower receiver-end inlet, upper flask-end outlet. Condenser and delivery adapter drain into mouth of open conical receiver with VISIBLE AIR GAP, no stopper. Mantle not flame. Everything connected properly, nothing sealed. Leave enough vertical canvas room above flask for a tall column in a later matched edit; flask low left. No fractional column in this version. Fine dark ink outlines and realistic pale blue-grey watercolour glass, subtle warm highlights, layered paint, not vector clip art. At least 10 percent clear margin all edges. No text, labels, graduations, numbers, logos, people, hands, faces, background or floor shadow. File y11c-simple-distillation-v1.png
